FN-2HDXIKI-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 280
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Joe Lovvorn
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/19/2024
House Bill 280 as introduced could increase the expenditures of local boards of education
beginning in the 2024-2025 school year by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to
implement fentanyl-specific drug education and prevention program curriculum required by the
provisions of this bill.
